تراقيت (form VI)

# تَرَاقَيْتَ (tarāqayta) /ta.raː.qaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَرَاقَى (tarāqā)
# تَرَاقَيْتِ (tarāqayti) /ta.raː.qaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَرَاقَى (tarāqā)
